messages.subject: Firm notice - document management system go-live this weekend
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Reminder that the firm's new document management system goes live this weekend. The DMS will be read-only from 6pm Friday until Monday morning. Please save any working drafts locally before close on Friday. IT will run a drop-in clinic on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Sarah
